vocabulary.name: Regime to family
vocabulary.description: Maps each of the nine canonical regimes to its parent RegimeFamily.

vocabulary.name: Regime axes
vocabulary.description: Returns the canonical identity basis and split-forcing transformation for a regime.

vocabulary.name: Regime profile axes
vocabulary.description: Returns the canonical axes associated with a regime profile.

vocabulary.name: Profile kind
vocabulary.description: Returns the canonical regime identifying a graph vertex profile.

vocabulary.name: Vertex regime type
vocabulary.description: Returns the canonical regime carried by a regime vertex.

vocabulary.name: Classification matrix
vocabulary.description: The canonical total map from Regime × Transformation to ClassificationValue.

vocabulary.name: Derived regime set
vocabulary.description: The canonical list containing all nine regimes used in the lower-bound argument.

vocabulary.name: Reference classification values
vocabulary.description: The canonical reference list IGN, PRS, BRK.

vocabulary.name: Reference families
vocabulary.description: The canonical reference list of the six regime families.

vocabulary.name: Reference profiles
vocabulary.description: The canonical reference list of the nine regimes in profile order.

vocabulary.name: Profiles for family
vocabulary.description: Returns the canonical regimes derived from one parent family.

vocabulary.name: Derived profiles from families
vocabulary.description: Flattens profilesForFamily over the canonical family list.

vocabulary.name: Reference transformations
vocabulary.description: The canonical reference list of ten transformations.

vocabulary.name: All matrix cells
vocabulary.description: The 90 Regime × Transformation pairs covered by the canonical matrix.

vocabulary.name: Count classification value
vocabulary.description: Counts cells carrying a selected ClassificationValue.

vocabulary.name: Regime applicable
vocabulary.description: Identifies the eight inapplicable cells of the canonical classification matrix.

vocabulary.name: Persistence classification
vocabulary.description: Constructs a Persistence classification from a regime's matrix row while restoring the eight inapplicable cells.

vocabulary.name: Scope AD strict model
vocabulary.description: AD on scopes declared as restructuring that preserves coverage.

vocabulary.name: Scope AD loose model
vocabulary.description: AD on scopes declared as restructuring that may also change coverage.

vocabulary.name: Scope extension basis
vocabulary.description: Extension-fixed scope basis: the invariant is the set of covered cases.

vocabulary.name: Scope structure basis
vocabulary.description: Structure-fixed scope basis: the invariant is the organization.

vocabulary.name: Rule RF strict model
vocabulary.description: RF on rules declared as a strict split that keeps coverage and every norm.

vocabulary.name: Rule RF loose model
vocabulary.description: RF on rules declared as a strict split that keeps coverage and may change norms.

vocabulary.name: Rule content basis
vocabulary.description: Content-fixed rule basis: the invariant relates each governed case to its norm.

vocabulary.name: Rule structure basis
vocabulary.description: Structure-fixed rule basis: the invariant is the organization of the provisions.

vocabulary.name: Fork model
vocabulary.description: BF on plain referents under a warrant: a continuation belongs to a different branch and satisfies the warrant.

vocabulary.name: Fork locus basis
vocabulary.description: Locus-fixed plain-referent basis: the invariant is the locus.

vocabulary.name: Fork object basis
vocabulary.description: Object-fixed plain-referent basis: the invariant is the object.

vocabulary.name: Scope entry field
vocabulary.description: The field for a pair of cases: whether the scope organization relates them.

vocabulary.name: Scope entry strict model
vocabulary.description: AD on scopes with one field per pair of cases, declared to preserve coverage; it writes only off-diagonal pairs.

vocabulary.name: Scope entry loose model
vocabulary.description: AD on scopes with one field per pair of cases, declared so that it may also change coverage.

vocabulary.name: Scope entry extension basis
vocabulary.description: Extension-fixed scope basis reading the diagonal pairs.

vocabulary.name: Scope entry structure basis
vocabulary.description: Structure-fixed scope basis reading every pair.

vocabulary.name: Rule entry field
vocabulary.description: The fields of a rule presentation: a pair of cases (whether the organization relates them) or a case (its norm).

vocabulary.name: Rule entry strict model
vocabulary.description: RF on rules with one field per dependency, declared as a strict split that keeps coverage and every norm; it writes only off-diagonal pairs.

vocabulary.name: Rule entry loose model
vocabulary.description: RF on rules with one field per dependency, declared as a strict split that keeps coverage and may change norms.

vocabulary.name: Rule entry content basis
vocabulary.description: Content-fixed rule basis reading the diagonal pairs and every norm.

vocabulary.name: Rule entry structure basis
vocabulary.description: Structure-fixed rule basis reading every pair and no norm.

vocabulary.name: Verdict to value
vocabulary.description: Maps a verdict to its classification value; not applicable and mixed have none.

vocabulary.name: Derived matrix
vocabulary.description: The derived classification matrix: a derived cell where a model has been written, and none elsewhere.

vocabulary.name: Derived value
vocabulary.description: The classification value of a derived cell, where there is one.

vocabulary.name: Derived verdict
vocabulary.description: The full derived verdict of a cell; none means no model has been written for it.
